subject: Call recap + PoC readiness & SDK / integration map
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Price <olivia.price@arcturushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Clinical-note summarization PoC — next steps and checklist

Hi Olivia / Evan —

Thanks again for taking time earlier today. Quick recap from our side so we’re all aligned and to capture next steps. If I misstated anything, please flag and I’ll update the record.

Key pain points you described:
- Clinicians spend ~6–8 minutes per patient writing notes; summarization could save ~30–45% of time.
- Current NLP attempts struggle with long discharge notes and produce hallucinated medication entries.
- Data residency and PHI controls are mandatory (on-prem or VPC option).

Primary goals for the PoC:
- Automatic outpatient visit summaries with >0.85 F1 on clinical entities and <=2s processing latency per note for interactive reviewer flow.
- Integration with your Epic extract pipeline (JSONL export) and ability to run on isolated VPC with KMS.
- Measure reviewer lift and false-positive rate vs. manual edits.

Current stack you shared:
- Epic for EHR; nightly batch extracts to S3 (S3-US-East).
- Reviewer UI is a React web app calling a Node backend.
- Authentication via Okta SSO; existing contract with AWS.

Proposed PoC approach (6-week plan):
- Week 0: Kickoff + NDA/SOW sign (owners: Jon — AM, Marissa — Solutions Eng).
- Week 1: Secure data pipeline (hashed PHI samples), establish VPC access and KMS test keys (Dev owner: Dev Patel).
- Week 2–3: Baseline model run on a 500-note seed set; prompt/template tuning and evaluation harness.
- Week 4: Integrate Redwood inference endpoint with a small reviewer cohort (10 clinicians).
- Week 5: Metrics collection & quality thresholds; run cost/latency analysis.
- Week 6: Final review and go/no-go decision; handoff plan for production rollout.

Integration notes / SDKs:
- Primary SDK we recommend for the PoC: Python (fast prototyping) and Node for reviewer UI (long-term).
- API compatibility: standard Redwood REST + streaming responses for progressive summary rendering; we'll provide a small Node client snippet for the reviewer flow.

Open items / asks from Arcturus:
1) Non-production sample export (500 de-identified notes) to the shared drive by Tue 4/13.
2) Confirmation on data residency (must remain in us-east region).
3) Availability for a 30-min kickoff next Tue or Wed morning PST.

Attachments: SOW-draft-v1.pdf (outline of scope), security-checklist.xlsx (SOC2/KMS questions), sample-epic-extract.jsonl (format example).

Next steps (I’ll schedule pending your preferred kickoff slot):
- Olivia: confirm sample export by 4/13 and preferred kickoff time.
- Marissa: I’ll loop you in for technical onboarding and SOW review.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

From: Olivia Price <olivia.price@arcturushealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Cole <evan.cole@arcturushealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Clinical-note summarization PoC — next steps and checklist

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the thorough recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Data residency: correct — we need processing to remain in US East (no data exported to other regions). Is Redwood able to guarantee that for the PoC in a hosted or dedicated mode?
2) PHI handling: we can provide a de-identified 500-note set by 4/13; full PHI access would need Private (VPC) deployment and KMS integration. Can you confirm estimated effort to stand up a VPC PoC (hours / infra lead time)?
3) Success criteria: the 0.85 F1 is reasonable — can you share the evaluation script you’ll use so we can align on entity labels?

We’re happy to do kickoff Tue 4/14 10:00–10:30 AM PST or Wed 4/15 9:00–9:30 AM PST. Prefer Tue if possible.

Olivia
VP Clinical Operations
Arcturus Health
olivia.price@arcturushealth.com | (650) 555-4421

Hi Olivia / Evan —

Great — thanks for the quick reply and the availability. Short answers below, and I added Dev on thread for the VPC/KMS estimates.

1) Data residency: Yes — for the PoC we can run in a US-East-only deployment. We have a Dedicated + Private deployment option that keeps data in your VPC; for the PoC we can offer a short-lived VPC deployment (4–8 weeks) with KMS integration.

2) VPC PoC estimate: Dev, can you confirm ballpark infra lead time?

3) Evaluation script: I’ll upload the evaluation harness and sample labeling schema to the shared drive after posting this email. It includes code for entity matching and F1 calculation.

Proposed kickoff: Tue 2027-04-14 10:00–10:30 AM PST — I’ll send a calendar invite once Olivia confirms.

Attachments: SOW-draft-v1.pdf

—
Jonas
